## Checklist

- [ ] Public API: `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` updated (1.x changes must be additive)
- [ ] **Documentation in this PR** (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation-is-part-of-every-feature)):
  - [ ] a how-to page or section with compiled examples in `docs/snippets/`
  - [ ] the in-depth guide, reference, concept or scenario pages it affects (diagrams where they help)
  - [ ] XML doc comments on public members
  - [ ] or: no user-visible change
- [ ] The docs build has no warnings (`dotnet docfx docs/docfx.json`)
